attachments.origin_landmark: medial orbital rim (frontal process of the maxilla / nasal part of the frontal bone), above the medial palpebral ligament
attachments.insertion_landmark: skin of the medial eyebrow, below corrugator supercilii (the schema takes a bone id; the true attachment is cartilage/skin and is named in the landmark text)

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population

fiber_architecture.evidence: no measured architecture recorded: no PCSA, fascicle length or force verified from a source for this muscle (Q65 rule: numbers only where a source gives them)

functional_compartments.function_note: Often described as the medial fibres of the orbital part of orbicularis oculi; TA and Z-Anatomy list it separately. Part of the glabellar complex with procerus and corrugator supercilii (botulinum frown-line treatment).
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
